cause_attribution.event_semantics: Each event means at least one error in the family; its conditional mean is the union of distinct affected scored pairs, possibly from multiple related omissions. Do not multiply by an additional unknown number of papers.
cause_attribution.correlation: No independence assumption. One missed theorem can affect disjoint retained and new pairs; those pair counts add while event probabilities remain correlated. Shared operational defects are charged once.
cause_attribution.numeric_limit: This is an intended attribution and sensitivity framework, not a fully elicited exact joint probability distribution.

followup_disposition.conclusion: Bounded follow-ups supply explicit QSZK/ETR operational bridges and inspect the named quantum/counting source chains. No concrete definition defect or changed baseline label was found.
followup_disposition.reason: These overlapping checks do not calibrate an omission rate. Retain the independent broad ledger rather than tune it to the earlier threshold.

stopping_decision.criterion: Bounded provisional revision prepared for user PR review; not an expected-error-below-two certification
stopping_decision.decision: Adopt the revisable historical decisions for this provisional snapshot after source/model reviews and exact-input checks. Present the residual uncertainty and coverage losses in the draft PR. Do not merge, tag, publish the release or deploy tkwa.me.

limitations: All pairs are indexed through domain and theorem-family reviews, not 2500 independent literature searches.
Negative searches do not prove openness; no statistical omission-detection rate is known.
The full scholarly literature, every journal or language, and unpublished arguments were not exhaustively searched.
Unchanged parent evidence is carried forward with a complete classification comparison; it was not all independently repeated for this revision.
Some domain reports bind partial overlays they actually reviewed. Final SAT, Lean, migration and validation reports bind the current merged dataset.
SAT concerns only the finite encoded theory; Lean inference traces assume cited mathematical premises.
Operational textbook-equivalence bridges and deep literature proofs remain trusted inputs. Explicit QSZK and ETR bridge arguments are not claimed as Lean theorems.
The risk ledger is judgmental and correlated; about three is not a measured error count or an upper bound.
The selection is editorial judgment among the current61; family counts and propagation counts are not importance weights or solution forecasts.
Only total binary decision-language classes are scored. Promise-only, search/function and algebraic questions can fall outside scope.
Historical eligibility admits a question, not a model answer. New proofs and run integrity still require their own reviews.
An overlooked accepted pre-cutoff result earns zero and triggers a recorded correction and any versioned rescore.

roster_migration.interpretation: Preserve old evidence and historical records; issue fresh decisions for the current exact taskset. This is not the unchanged-mathematics policy adoption used for v0.3.1.
